choices: Weeks are ISO (isoyear, isoweek) groups of bench rows; week t-k means the k-th preceding week present in the bench, not a calendar offset.

Weekly return is the product of (1 + daily return) over the week's bench days, a daily return being close/previous bench row's close - 1; the week is undefined if any GVIP or QQQ daily return in it is undefined, including the first day's link to the prior week.
Basket weekly return compounds W over the week's bench days; undefined if any W in the week is NaN (or QQQ's week is undefined).
W is mapped onto bench days by date: W[k] on B's day k is taken as the return on that date; bench days absent from B's days get NaN. A B day missing from the bench is dropped.
Signal: x_t <= numpy.percentile(x[t-104..t-1], 10) (linear), requiring all 104 window weeks defined and x_t defined.
Week end for the episode rule is the date of week t's last bench row; excluded when |week_end - episode week_end| <= 14 calendar days for any episode row (D or N).

Entry is the bench row after week t's last bench row; exit is entry + h rows. For GVIP and QQQ the forward window is defined when both closes at entry and exit are present (intermediate days not required).
Basket R_t = prod(1 + W) over rows entry+1..exit - 1, minus (QQQ exit/entry - 1); defined only if every W in that span is present and QQQ endpoints are present.
The basket test uses its own signal (basket weekly minus QQQ weekly, own 104-week window) and its own eligible set.
For h5 and h10 the eligible set is recomputed with that horizon's forward window; the signal definition is unchanged. h5/h10/declustered are GVIP-QQQ only.

De-clustered: an eligible signal week is kept if none of the 4 preceding bench weeks is a signal week, a signal week being any week meeting the signal definition whether eligible or not. The permutation pool is the full eligible set at 20 days.

Permutation: pool = eligible R in date order; n = number of (relevant) signal weeks; observed = mean of the signal weeks' R; 10,000 draws rng.choice(pool, n, replace=False).mean() from a fresh default_rng(20261029) per test; p = (1 + #(draw >= observed)) / 10001. p is null when n is 0 or n exceeds the pool.
Verdict: INSUFFICIENT if n_signal < 20; else SUPPORTED if p_upper <= 0.05; else NOT SUPPORTED. The same rule is applied to the basket.
Trade: eligible signals in date order; a signal is skipped when its week's last bench row (the moment it is read) is before the open trade's exit row, i.e. entry_idx <= prev exit_idx.
Trade net = R - 0.004 - 0.005 * 20 / 252, days_held being trading rows between entry and exit.
t_mean = mean / (sample sd ddof=1 / sqrt(n)); null when fewer than 2 trades or sd is 0. share_profitable is the share with net > 0.
Years spanned = (last eligible week end - first eligible week end) in days / 365.25, using that series' 20-day eligible set (GVIP for trade_gvip, basket for trade_basket).
